purpose: Local prototype reference / Noita, Nolla Games
reaction_notes: Curated subset: exact matches use source probability*100 gates; unmatched rules keep project denominators. Invocation frequency, source-A ownership and commit semantics remain project choices.

electricity_reference.prototype_notes: Pulse branching, conductor defaults, costs, afterglow and heat conversion are project rules; spark_electric is not treated as an electricity source.

restricted_blob_reference.prototype_notes: Source records use restricted radial sampling or an unrestricted strict disk; missing restriction flags retain recovered constructor true. Authored legacy records retain connected disks. Float trigonometry, runtime precision, scheduling and atomic multi-output conflict handling are not claimed to reproduce the entire original world pipeline.

phase_reference.notes: Source T is a signed random threshold, separate from project stored heat. Liquid blocker maps to project motion state; original state byte/float writers remain unknown. Existing stable cold/warm target mappings are retained; full original reverse-target overwrite order is not claimed.

body_explosion_reference.prototype_notes: Source solid type, density, durability, HP, fuel, minimum radius and ray energy are retained. Four-tick fuse, smoke residue, heat, area impulse, inertia response, ray sampling, cluster growth and pressure-unit mapping remain project rules; this does not import an explosive-crate entity or recover private engine formulas.

body_contact_reference.prototype_notes: Explicit inherited solid_friction is retained; omitted values use the project fallback, not a recovered original default. Mapping to Box2D shape friction and its default geometric-mean mixing is a project integration; original contact/float formulas remain unverified.

liquid_flow_reference.prototype_notes: Local probe budget, not physical reach. Connected own-liquid columns and finite-row fallback share nearest downward outlet queries. Movement remains cell-by-cell; cache, row wake scope and velocity units are project rules, not recovered Noita formulas.

combustion_reference.prototype_notes: Missing attributes use explicitly project-owned fallbacks. Per-cell/tick deterministic 15-bit LCG streams and fixed-step scheduling differ from the unrecovered world scheduler. Source signed intensity byte, sampled ignition, single upper emission slot, flame-placement feedback and separate liquid/body burnout branches are supported. Body global-counter checks map to fixed tick. Gas countdown and fire lifetime remain project approximations; target-type predicates for scorching are not fully recovered.

reaction_dispatch_reference.prototype_notes: Exact supported source matches use shared 15-bit samples, probability*100 gates, oriented cardinal/third-neighbor selection and direct-world radial/strict-disk geometry. Missing blob restriction flags retain recovered constructor true. One ordinary and one fast attempt per active cell/fixed tick, source A anchoring, dirty wake scheduling and atomic C/B/A staged conflict handling are project choices. Unmatched curated recipes retain project sampling. ReqReaction is supported without importing new vegetation; threaded request consumption, environment bytes, convert_all and entity/audio effects remain unrecovered.

source_interaction_reference.gas_notes: Signed +/-30% initial counter and increment on actual swaps; no unconditional tick increment. Other original writers remain unknown. Existing fire lifetime and gas movement remain project models.
source_interaction_reference.electric_notes: Brush parameters: energy1000 speed32 heat0.1 splitting count2 threshold500 glow10; tick maps source time, unknown cell marker false, no environment exception. Sources/receivers and crack components not instantiated.
source_interaction_reference.explosion_notes: 360 grid probes read persistent HP, strict radius and source creation gate. Angle binning, body geometry/pressure and fuse aggregation remain project rules; unknown sine edge modifiers, sparks and delay queues are not imported.

adhesion_reference.notes: Raw source threshold, coordinate-selected top/side attachment, Random15%101<20 maintenance gate, support loss and empty-below release. Existing strength/span/duration fields are retained for old authored/save compatibility but ignored in source mode. Fixed-step schedule, per-cell random stream and mapping of represented support states are project integration; full sand movement states remain unrecovered.

liquid_motion_reference.scope: Ordinary non-static, non-sand, non-slime liquids only. Recovered fall/lateral accumulators and density gate; fixed-step ordering, extra-fall lateral selection, impulses and rigid displacement remain project adaptations. No pressure projection or global outlet search in this branch. Slime/sand motion is unchanged.
